Empty of people. Something close on one side of the frame, the rest of the scene falling away into soft depth; nothing large blocking the bottom of the frame. Cinematic natural light, deep colour, no text. Painterly fantasy illustration, warm detailed rendering. Scene: a cluttered wizard study at night, potion shelves and scrolls, an orrery, candlelight and faint blue magic glow, a round window with stars, night light.
